# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_targetable_<key>  THIS may send its next fleet there: unclaimed, and under
#                           races only of a stage reached (the draw's candidates), under
#                           simple and full of stage 1 or 2, or with Deep Space
#                           Exploration or a colony held (design § 3)
#   sr_cf_departs_<key>     a fleet can leave for it this month (its body's window, a
#                           paid launch the approach accepts, or a torch; Mercury always)
#   sr_cf_eligible_<key>    the automatic pick may take it: targetable, departs, its cost
#                           covered, its transit within 180 months (design § 7);
#                           the goal alone first, the cheap test before the window's
#   sr_cf_beaten_<key>      a fleet already on its way lands no later than ours would
sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = {
	NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
	OR = {
		AND = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } sr_current_colonization_stage >= 1 }
		sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
	}
}
sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = { sr_launch_target_cost_mars < sr_launch_never }
sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = {
	sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
	sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris
	sr_transit_months_mars <= sr_cf_horizon_months
}
sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = {
	has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris
	sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris >= global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris
}

# The country's target (var:sr_cf_target, a world's index) is still targetable.
sr_cf_target_valid = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 6 sr_cf_targetable_ceres = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 sr_cf_targetable_vesta = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 sr_cf_targetable_psyche = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 9 sr_cf_targetable_pallas = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 10 sr_cf_targetable_hygiea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 11 sr_cf_targetable_io = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 12 sr_cf_targetable_europa = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 13 sr_cf_targetable_ganymede = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 14 sr_cf_targetable_callisto = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 15 sr_cf_targetable_himalia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 16 sr_cf_targetable_amalthea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 17 sr_cf_targetable_venus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 18 sr_cf_targetable_mercury = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 19 sr_cf_targetable_titan = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 20 sr_cf_targetable_enceladus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 21 sr_cf_targetable_rhea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 22 sr_cf_targetable_mimas = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 23 sr_cf_targetable_iapetus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 24 sr_cf_targetable_titania = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 25 sr_cf_targetable_oberon = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 26 sr_cf_targetable_miranda = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 27 sr_cf_targetable_ariel = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 28 sr_cf_targetable_triton = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 29 sr_cf_targetable_proteus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 30 sr_cf_targetable_pluto = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 31 sr_cf_targetable_eris = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 32 sr_cf_targetable_makemake = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 33 sr_cf_targetable_haumea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 34 sr_cf_targetable_sedna = yes }
	}
}

# The target can be launched for now: targetable, departs, its cost covered.
sr_cf_target_ready = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes sr_cf_departs_olympus_mons = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_olympus_mons }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_hellas_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_hellas_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_utopia_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_utopia_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_arcadia_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 6 sr_cf_targetable_ceres = yes sr_cf_departs_ceres = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_ceres }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 sr_cf_targetable_vesta = yes sr_cf_departs_vesta = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_vesta }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 sr_cf_targetable_psyche = yes sr_cf_departs_psyche = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_psyche }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 9 sr_cf_targetable_pallas = yes sr_cf_departs_pallas = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_pallas }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 10 sr_cf_targetable_hygiea = yes sr_cf_departs_hygiea = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_hygiea }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 11 sr_cf_targetable_io = yes sr_cf_departs_io = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_io }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 12 sr_cf_targetable_europa = yes sr_cf_departs_europa = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_europa }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 13 sr_cf_targetable_ganymede = yes sr_cf_departs_ganymede = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_ganymede }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 14 sr_cf_targetable_callisto = yes sr_cf_departs_callisto = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_callisto }

		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 16 sr_cf_targetable_amalthea = yes sr_cf_departs_amalthea = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_amalthea }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 17 sr_cf_targetable_venus = yes sr_cf_departs_venus = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_venus }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 18 sr_cf_targetable_mercury = yes sr_cf_departs_mercury = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_mercury }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 19 sr_cf_targetable_titan = yes sr_cf_departs_titan = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_titan }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 20 sr_cf_targetable_enceladus = yes sr_cf_departs_enceladus = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_enceladus }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 21 sr_cf_targetable_rhea = yes sr_cf_departs_rhea = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_rhea }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 22 sr_cf_targetable_mimas = yes sr_cf_departs_mimas = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_mimas }

		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 25 sr_cf_targetable_oberon = yes sr_cf_departs_oberon = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_oberon }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 26 sr_cf_targetable_miranda = yes sr_cf_departs_miranda = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_miranda }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 27 sr_cf_targetable_ariel = yes sr_cf_departs_ariel = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_ariel }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 28 sr_cf_targetable_triton = yes sr_cf_departs_triton = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_triton }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 29 sr_cf_targetable_proteus = yes sr_cf_departs_proteus = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_proteus }

# The scripted GUIs' world (scope:site): targetable, our target, held by THIS.
sr_cf_scope_site_targetable = {
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:site = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 6 sr_cf_targetable_ceres = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 7 sr_cf_targetable_vesta = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 8 sr_cf_targetable_psyche = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 9 sr_cf_targetable_pallas = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 10 sr_cf_targetable_hygiea = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 11 sr_cf_targetable_io = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 12 sr_cf_targetable_europa = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 13 sr_cf_targetable_ganymede = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 14 sr_cf_targetable_callisto = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 15 sr_cf_targetable_himalia = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 16 sr_cf_targetable_amalthea = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 17 sr_cf_targetable_venus = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 18 sr_cf_targetable_mercury = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 19 sr_cf_targetable_titan = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 20 sr_cf_targetable_enceladus = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 21 sr_cf_targetable_rhea = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 22 sr_cf_targetable_mimas = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 23 sr_cf_targetable_iapetus = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 24 sr_cf_targetable_titania = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 25 sr_cf_targetable_oberon = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 26 sr_cf_targetable_miranda = yes }
		AND = { scope:site = 27 sr_cf_targetable_ariel = yes }

sr_cf_scope_site_is_target = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:site = 1 var:sr_cf_target = 1 }
		AND = { scope:site = 2 var:sr_cf_target = 2 }
		AND = { scope:site = 3 var:sr_cf_target = 3 }
		AND = { scope:site = 4 var:sr_cf_target = 4 }
		AND = { scope:site = 5 var:sr_cf_target = 5 }
		AND = { scope:site = 6 var:sr_cf_target = 6 }
		AND = { scope:site = 7 var:sr_cf_target = 7 }
		AND = { scope:site = 8 var:sr_cf_target = 8 }
		AND = { scope:site = 9 var:sr_cf_target = 9 }
		AND = { scope:site = 10 var:sr_cf_target = 10 }
		AND = { scope:site = 11 var:sr_cf_target = 11 }
		AND = { scope:site = 12 var:sr_cf_target = 12 }
		AND = { scope:site = 13 var:sr_cf_target = 13 }
		AND = { scope:site = 14 var:sr_cf_target = 14 }
		AND = { scope:site = 15 var:sr_cf_target = 15 }
		AND = { scope:site = 16 var:sr_cf_target = 16 }
		AND = { scope:site = 17 var:sr_cf_target = 17 }
		AND = { scope:site = 18 var:sr_cf_target = 18 }
		AND = { scope:site = 19 var:sr_cf_target = 19 }
		AND = { scope:site = 20 var:sr_cf_target = 20 }
		AND = { scope:site = 21 var:sr_cf_target = 21 }
		AND = { scope:site = 22 var:sr_cf_target = 22 }
		AND = { scope:site = 23 var:sr_cf_target = 23 }
		AND = { scope:site = 24 var:sr_cf_target = 24 }
		AND = { scope:site = 25 var:sr_cf_target = 25 }
		AND = { scope:site = 26 var:sr_cf_target = 26 }
		AND = { scope:site = 27 var:sr_cf_target = 27 }
		AND = { scope:site = 28 var:sr_cf_target = 28 }
		AND = { scope:site = 29 var:sr_cf_target = 29 }
		AND = { scope:site = 30 var:sr_cf_target = 30 }

# ===== Modules (slice 4 design §§ 2, 5-6) =====
# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_mq_any_<key>               THIS has a module of it queued
#   sr_mod_can_queue_<type>_<key> THIS may queue one more: it holds the world, the
#                                 cap has room counting queue and shipments, and a
#                                 specialization's founding choice is made
#   sr_mod_departs_<key>          a module can leave for it this month at no premium
# Any scope: sr_site_shipping_<key>, a module is on its way there.
sr_mq_any_valles_marineris = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = sr_mq_hab_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_a_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_b_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_port_valles_marineris
		has_variable = sr_mq_def_valles_marineris
	}
}
sr_mod_can_queue_a_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
	sr_mod_spec_used_valles_marineris < sr_mod_spec_budget
}
sr_mod_can_queue_b_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
	sr_mod_spec_used_valles_marineris < sr_mod_spec_budget
}
sr_mod_can_queue_hab_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris < 4
}
sr_mod_can_queue_def_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris < 4
}
sr_mod_can_queue_port_valles_marineris = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
	sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris < 4
}
sr_mod_departs_valles_marineris = { sr_mod_departs = { BODY = mars } }
sr_site_shipping_valles_marineris = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris
	}
}

sr_mod_can_queue_port_sedna = {
	global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this
	sr_mod_slots_used_sedna < 1
}
sr_mod_departs_sedna = { sr_mod_departs = { BODY = kuiper } }
sr_site_shipping_sedna = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_sedna
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_sedna
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_sedna
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_sedna
		has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_sedna
	}
}
